aou_req__persistency__error_handling.content:
The application shall detect and handle the unavailability of the feature persistency.
Unavailability covers errors reported by the persistency API as well as persistency calls which do
not return or return too late (e.g. caused by blocked or delayed execution of the calling context).
aou_req__persistency__error_handling.title: Persistency Error handling

comp_req__kvs__async_api.content: The component shall provide an asynchronous API for flush function in addition to the standard API.
comp_req__kvs__async_api.title: Async API

comp_req__kvs__atomic_store.content: The component shall persist all key-value pairs of a flush operation atomically, such that either all changes are written or none are.
comp_req__kvs__atomic_store.title: Atomic Store

comp_req__kvs__cached_access.content: The component shall hold key-value pairs in an in-memory cache and shall serve read and write access to key-value pairs from that cache.
comp_req__kvs__cached_access.title: Cached Access

comp_req__kvs__callback_support.content: The component shall provide an API for registering callbacks that are triggered by data change events.
comp_req__kvs__callback_support.title: Callback Support

comp_req__kvs__concurrency.content:
The component shall implement thread-safe mechanisms to enable concurrent
access to data without data races.
comp_req__kvs__concurrency.title: Concurrency

comp_req__kvs__constraints.content:
The component shall allow configuration of KVS constraints at compile-time
using source code constants or at runtime using a configuration file.
comp_req__kvs__constraints.title: Constraint Configuration

comp_req__kvs__constraints_priority.content: The component shall give configurations provided by file higher priority than compile-time configurations.
comp_req__kvs__constraints_priority.title: Constraint Configuration priority

comp_req__kvs__corruption_detect_open.content: The component shall detect an interrupted or corrupted storage file, via its integrity check, when a KVS instance is opened, and shall not automatically load the affected storage.
comp_req__kvs__corruption_detect_open.title: Corruption Detection on Open

comp_req__kvs__default_storage_permissio.content: The component shall generate the default-values storage file, via the provided kvs tool, with read-only file permissions ``440`` (owner and group read, others none), so that the default storage deployed with the application cannot be modified at runtime.
comp_req__kvs__default_storage_permissio.title: Default Storage File Permissions

comp_req__kvs__default_val_chksum.content:
The component shall secure the configuration file for default values with an
associated checksum file when default values are stored in a file.
comp_req__kvs__default_val_chksum.title: Default Value Checksum

comp_req__kvs__default_value_cfg.content:
The component shall allow configuration of default values in a
separate storage file generated by provided kvs tool.
comp_req__kvs__default_value_cfg.title: Default Value Config

comp_req__kvs__default_value_cfg_tool.content: The component shall provide a tool to generate the default value storage file and its corresponding checksum file.
comp_req__kvs__default_value_cfg_tool.title: Default Value Config tool

comp_req__kvs__default_value_is_default_.content: The component shall provide a capability to report whether a key has not been explicitly written and a default value is available for it.
comp_req__kvs__default_value_is_default_.title: Default Value Status Query

comp_req__kvs__default_value_query.content: The component shall provide an API to retrieve default values even if value is set by the user.
comp_req__kvs__default_value_query.title: Default Value Query

comp_req__kvs__default_value_types.content: The component shall accept default values of only the value data types specified in :need:`comp_req__kvs__value_data_types`.
comp_req__kvs__default_value_types.title: Default Value Datatypes

comp_req__kvs__discard_pending_changes_a.content: The component shall provide a capability to reload key-value pairs from persistent storage, discarding every in-memory change made since the last successful flush operation (or since open, if flush was never called), without affecting default values.
comp_req__kvs__discard_pending_changes_a.title: Discard Pending Changes

comp_req__kvs__explicit_flush.content: The component shall persist in-memory key-value changes to storage only when the user explicitly calls the flush operation, and shall not flush automatically.
comp_req__kvs__explicit_flush.title: Explicit Flush

comp_req__kvs__explicit_snapshot_operati.content: The component shall perform snapshot creation, restoration, and deletion only when explicitly triggered by the user through the corresponding APIs.
comp_req__kvs__explicit_snapshot_operati.title: Explicit Snapshot Operations

comp_req__kvs__key_encoding.content: The component shall encode each key as valid ASCII, compatible with UTF-8.
comp_req__kvs__key_encoding.title: Key Encoding

comp_req__kvs__key_exists_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to report whether a key has been explicitly written, returning ``false`` for a key that was never written even if a default value is available for it.
comp_req__kvs__key_exists_api.title: Key Existence Check

comp_req__kvs__key_length.content: The component shall disallow empty keys and limit the maximum length of a key to 32 bytes.
comp_req__kvs__key_length.title: Key Length

comp_req__kvs__key_list_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to retrieve the set of keys that have been explicitly written, excluding keys that only have a default value.
comp_req__kvs__key_list_api.title: Key Listing

comp_req__kvs__key_naming.content: The component shall accept keys that consist solely of printable ASCII characters (0x20 - 0x7E).
comp_req__kvs__key_naming.title: Key Naming

comp_req__kvs__key_remove_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to delete a single explicitly-written key-value pair from the in-memory cache.
comp_req__kvs__key_remove_api.title: Key Removal

comp_req__kvs__key_uniqueness.content: The component shall ensure that keys are unique within a KVS instance and shall report an error when loading storage that contains duplicate keys.
comp_req__kvs__key_uniqueness.title: Key Uniqueness

comp_req__kvs__key_value_overwrite.content: The component shall overwrite the existing value with the new value when a value is set for a key that already exists.
comp_req__kvs__key_value_overwrite.title: Key Value Overwrite

comp_req__kvs__language_bindings.content: The component shall provide API bindings for both the C++ and Rust programming languages.
comp_req__kvs__language_bindings.title: Language Bindings

comp_req__kvs__multi_instance.content:
The component shall support the concurrent existence of multiple KVS
instances, such that operations on one instance do not affect the data or
state of any other instance.
comp_req__kvs__multi_instance.title: Multi-Instance

comp_req__kvs__no_dynamic_memory.content: The component shall not allocate heap memory after a KVS instance has been successfully created or opened. All memory required for the instance's operation shall be allocated during its opening, with the constraints defined by :need:`comp_req__kvs__constraints`.
comp_req__kvs__no_dynamic_memory.title: No Dynamic Memory Allocation at Runtime

comp_req__kvs__open_need_kvs_behavior.title: Open Behavior on Missing or Corrupted Storage

comp_req__kvs__os_abstraction.content: The component shall access operating system services exclusively through an operating system abstraction layer.
comp_req__kvs__os_abstraction.title: Operating System Abstraction

comp_req__kvs__permission_control.content:
The component shall rely on the underlying filesystem for access and
permission management and shall not implement its own access or permission
controls.
comp_req__kvs__permission_control.title: Permission Control

comp_req__kvs__permission_err_hndl.content:
The component shall report any access or permission errors encountered at
the filesystem level to the application.
comp_req__kvs__permission_err_hndl.title: Permission Error Handling

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum.content:
The component shall generate a checksum for each data file and shall store
it alongside the data.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum.title: Persistent Data Storage Checksum Write

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum_vrfy.content: The component shall verify the checksum when loading data, and shall report an error and not load the affected data when the checksum does not match.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum_vrfy.title: Persistent Data Storage Checksum Verify

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_migration.content:
The component shall migrate persisted data between supported schema versions
without involvement of the application.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_migration.title: Persistent Data Migration

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_schema.content:
The component shall use a JSON file storage format in which the schema
version identifier is a dedicated top-level field, separate from the
key-value payload.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_schema.title: Persistent Data Schema

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_bnd.content: The component shall use the file API to persist data.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_bnd.title: Persistent Data Storage Backend

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_fmt.content: The component shall use the JSON data format to persist data.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_fmt.title: Persistent Data Storage Format

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_version.content:
The component shall store a schema version identifier in each persisted data
file.
comp_req__kvs__pers_data_version.title: Persistent Data Versioning

comp_req__kvs__random_access_complexity.content: The component shall provide random read access to a key-value pair with at most logarithmic time complexity relative to the number of stored key-value pairs.
comp_req__kvs__random_access_complexity.title: Random Access Time Complexity

comp_req__kvs__recovery_snapshot_restore.content: The component shall allow the user to explicitly restore a snapshot of their choice in order to recover the data after an interrupted or corrupted storage has been detected.
comp_req__kvs__recovery_snapshot_restore.title: Recovery via Snapshot Restore

comp_req__kvs__reset_resistant_write.content: The component shall perform flush operations such that the previously persisted consistent data remains intact until a new flush operation has completed successfully.
comp_req__kvs__reset_resistant_write.title: Reset Resistant Write

comp_req__kvs__single_process_access.content: The component shall prevent a single KVS instance from being opened concurrently by more than one OS process.
comp_req__kvs__single_process_access.title: Single Process Access

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_create.content: The component shall create a new snapshot in the selected snapshot slot when the slot is empty.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_create.title: Snapshot Create

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_create_api.content:
The component shall provide an API for creating a snapshot in the slot selected by index.
See :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_id_api` and :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali`.


.. note::

   A snapshot is a point-in-time, frozen view of all values in a key-value storage.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_create_api.title: Snapshot Create API

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_id_api.content:
The component shall identify snapshot slots by a one-based index in the range ``<1..3>``, where the first slot has index ``1``, the second slot has index ``2`` and the third slot has index ``3``.
See :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_max_num_cfg`.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_id_api.title: Snapshot Slot Indexing

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_max_num_cfg.content:
The component shall maintain a configurable maximum number of snapshots.
The maximum number shall be in the range ``<0..3>``.
A value of zero shall disable snapshot operations.
A non-zero value shall specify the maximum number of snapshots.
Default value shall be: ``3``.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_max_num_cfg.title: Maximum Number of Snapshots

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_overwrite.content: The component shall overwrite the selected snapshot slot when the slot is occupied.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_overwrite.title: Snapshot Overwrite

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_remove_api.content:
The component shall provide an API for removing the snapshot in the slot selected by index, and shall return an error when that slot is free.
See :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali`.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_remove_api.title: Snapshot Remove API

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_restore_api.content:
The component shall provide an API for restoring the snapshot in the slot selected by index, and shall return an error when that slot is free.
See :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali`.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_restore_api.title: Snapshot Restore API

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_free_api.content:
The component shall provide an API to check whether the slot selected by index is free or occupied.
See :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali`.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_free_api.title: Snapshot Slot Free Query API

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali.content: The component shall return an error from every snapshot API that accepts a slot index when the provided index is zero or outside the range defined in :need:`comp_req__kvs__snapshot_id_api`.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_slot_index_vali.title: Snapshot Slot Index Validation

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_source.content:
The component shall use the live values set by the user, regardless of whether the values
have been flushed to disk.
comp_req__kvs__snapshot_source.title: Snapshot Data Source

comp_req__kvs__storage_backend_select.content: The component shall allow the storage backend used by a KVS instance to be selected via a compile-time configuration parameter.
comp_req__kvs__storage_backend_select.title: Storage Backend Selection

comp_req__kvs__storage_file_permissions.content: The component shall create storage files with file permissions ``640`` (owner read and write, group read, others none).
comp_req__kvs__storage_file_permissions.title: Storage File Permissions

comp_req__kvs__storage_tool.content: The component shall provide a tool to view, modify and validate storage files.
comp_req__kvs__storage_tool.title: Storage Tool

comp_req__kvs__store_reset_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to remove all explicitly-written key-value pairs from the in-memory cache, restoring the KVS instance to its initial, empty state.
comp_req__kvs__store_reset_api.title: Store Reset

comp_req__kvs__value_data_types.content:
The component shall accept only values of the following data types: Number,
String, Boolean, Null, Array[Value], or Dictionary{Key:Value}.
comp_req__kvs__value_data_types.title: Value Data Types

comp_req__kvs__value_default.content: The component shall provide an API ``get_default_value`` to retrieve the default value of a key when no value has been set by the user.
comp_req__kvs__value_default.title: Value Default

comp_req__kvs__value_get_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to retrieve the in-memory value associated with a key, returning the default value (see :need:`comp_req__kvs__value_default`) when the key has not been explicitly written.
comp_req__kvs__value_get_api.title: Value Retrieval

comp_req__kvs__value_reset.content:
The component shall provide an API to reset a value to its default when a default value is defined.

.. note::
   The default value can be retrieved via the ``get_default_value`` API.
comp_req__kvs__value_reset.title: Value Reset

comp_req__kvs__value_serialize.content: The component shall serialize and deserialize all values to and from JSON.
comp_req__kvs__value_serialize.title: Value Serialization

comp_req__kvs__value_set_api.content: The component shall provide a capability to store a value for a given key in the in-memory cache, overwriting any previously written value for that key (see :need:`comp_req__kvs__key_value_overwrite`).
comp_req__kvs__value_set_api.title: Value Store

comp_req__kvs__write_amplification.content: The component shall write key-value data to the storage backend only when the in-memory data has changed since the last successful flush operation.
comp_req__kvs__write_amplification.title: Write Amplification Minimization

feat_saf_dfa__persistency__execution_blo.content:
Persistency is executed in the execution context of the calling application. A blocking of this execution
(e.g. by the application itself or by the scheduling of the OS) will make persistency not available, i.e. a
persistency call does not return or returns too late. This unavailability is handled by the application
according to aou_req__persistency__error_handling.
feat_saf_dfa__persistency__execution_blo.failure_effect: Blocking of execution. This will lead to a unavailability of the persistency feature.
feat_saf_dfa__persistency__execution_blo.title: Persistency execution blocking

feat_saf_fmea__persistency__corrupted_me.failure_effect: message is corrupted so the feature persistency is not available.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__corrupted_me.title: Message is corrupted
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__corrupted_me.type_name: Feature FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)

feat_saf_fmea__persistency__err_handl.content:
User is not able to use the feature. Middleware cant be used. Loss of execution can only be caused by the application, not by the persistency feature itself.
Failure handling is addressed to the application by the aou_req__persistency__error_handling.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__err_handl.failure_effect: loss of execution will lead to an unavailability of the persistency feature.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__err_handl.title: Loss of execution
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__err_handl.type_name: Feature FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)

feat_saf_fmea__persistency__late_message.content: Subset of MF_01_01 if the delay is too long.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__late_message.title: Message received too late
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__late_message.type_name: Feature FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)

feat_saf_fmea__persistency__msg_not_rece.content:
User is not able to use the feature. Middleware cant be used. Loss of execution can only be caused by the application, not by the persistency feature itself.
Failure handling is addressed to the application by the aou_req__persistency__error_handling.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__msg_not_rece.failure_effect: Message is not received so the feature persistency is not available.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__msg_not_rece.title: Message is not received
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__msg_not_rece.type_name: Feature FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)

feat_saf_fmea__persistency__not_sent.content: Covered by MF_01_01 because the violation cause is the same.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__not_sent.failure_effect: message is not sent so the feature persistency is not available.
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__not_sent.title: Message is not sent
feat_saf_fmea__persistency__not_sent.type_name: Feature FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis)

mod_vrep__persistency__report.title: Persistency Module Verification Report

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
